title: Starting Rate of the Hometown Heroes Award by Census Tract Income Level
content:
The starting rate of the Larkspur Hometown Heroes Credit award follows the census tract income level of the property, as recorded on the borrower's Mortgage Loan File.

| Census tract income level | Starting rate (percent of the base loan amount) |
|---|---|
| low | 0.20 percent |
| moderate | 0.20 percent |
| middle | 0.15 percent |
| upper | 0.12 percent |

**Clause.** A low-income or moderate-income tract takes 0.20 percent of the base loan amount, an upper-income tract takes 0.12 percent, and a middle-income tract takes the 0.15 percent rate.

The starting rate is applied to the base loan amount and the result rounded to the cent; that rounded figure is the starting amount of the award.

### Worked figures (hypothetical base loan amount of 400000.00)

| Tract level | Starting amount |
|---|---|
| low or moderate | 800.00 |
| middle | 600.00 |
| upper | 480.00 |
